requirements.text: The system must allow users to colour-code classes for different modules.
The system must provide an option to hide cancelled classes.
The system must allow users to add personal study blocks to the timetable.
The system must send notifications through the portal when a grade is posted.
The system must provide the option for email notifications when a grade is posted.
The system must allow users to provide feedback on the quality of content and delivery of modules.
The feedback process must be straightforward and ideally through a simple form.
The feedback submission must be quick and easy.
